title: RAW complete diagram account distinguishes passage through a junction from merely facing inward
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_INCOMPLETE. The already owned f67v2 native audit records a central structure with four attached axial structures and four detached inward-facing corner clusters. A proposed whole diagram account distinguishes continuous passage from directed facing: two passages sharing the same central junction compose into a route, whereas inward-facing detached clusters do not acquire a drawn route merely by being aimed at the center. This is a whole-clause/co-reference constraint, not a word for a junction, a nine-name lookup, a calendar model or a Rosettes alignment. No target text or new image was opened.

design.mechanism: One fixed relation code in a complete textual account denotes traversable continuity along drawn joins; another may denote directed facing. Identity of the intermediate participant is preserved across consecutive clauses. The difference cannot be repaired by making the same relation mean continuous passage for an axial object but mere orientation for a corner object.
design.unit: The entire already owned f67v2 prose unit set with its true physical paragraph boundaries, plus the existing native coarse topology observation. An isolated ring fragment, label, selected line or a selected pair of clauses is insufficient.
design.contrast: A finite route description with shared intermediate participants versus an orientation/inventory account of objects directed toward the center. The latter is a credible rival because the recorded corner clusters face inward while detached.
design.prediction: When two fixed clauses assert passage from X to the same C and from that C to Y, the whole reading entails a continuous drawn route from X to Y. This is supported in principle for attached axial structures through the central structure; it is incompatible with a reading that licenses the same continuous passage from a detached corner cluster solely because it faces inward. Unknown endpoint ownership or an unbound clause yields no test, not contradiction.
design.scope: A literal diagram-reference hypothesis about drawn continuity, not a claim about real-world air/water transport, geographic roads, cardinal winds, celestial periods or construction chronology.

positive_facts: f67v2 has one central square-rosette, four directly attached axial structures and four detached corner face clusters pointing inward.
The separate Rosettes drawing has nine full circular compartments joined by a road network, but no exact node map, unique rotation or text-slot transfer was established.
limits: Corner clusters, not individual faces, are the nominated units; disputed or corrected face counts are irrelevant.
The coarse source does not supply a complete edge list or a complete local port inventory.
No Rosettes text, path, edge assignment or comparative score is nominated. Its contrast motivates separating attachment from mere shared scaffold only.
A detached drawn cluster need not be causally isolated in the represented world. The proposed relation is literal drawn continuity; interpreting wind or influence across a gap is a different model.

fixed_semantic_kernel.domain: The same drawn object occurrences across the complete account, not nine newly invented place names. Each occurrence-to-picture mapping must be explicit; whole classes may be quantified only if the text reading actually supplies that scope.
fixed_semantic_kernel.PASSAGE(X,Y): A continuous drawn join licenses passage between X and Y. This proposal takes passage as undirected; directional flow is not introduced.
fixed_semantic_kernel.FACES(X,Y): X is depicted as directed toward Y; this does not assert a connecting path or license PASSAGE.
fixed_semantic_kernel.composition: PASSAGE(X,C) and PASSAGE(C,Y), with literal co-reference of C, entail REACHABLE(X,Y). Merely repeating a spelling does not establish that co-reference.
fixed_semantic_kernel.adverse_case: A whole reading assigns PASSAGE to a detached inward-facing corner cluster and the central object, or carries that cluster through the same shared-C composition without any explicitly bound drawn connector. Under this literal-continuity model the corner relation is incompatible; replacing PASSAGE with FACES at that one occurrence is forbidden.
not_a_requirement: No promise that every depicted object is mentioned.
No fixed caption argument count or one word per node.
No compulsory numerical words, exact shape names, equal prose lengths or same cross-page spelling.
No shortest-path, Euler-traversal, cyclic order, unique rotation, road direction or complete port-count assertion.
fixed_semantic_kernel.unknown_policy: Any unresolved word, clause scope, endpoint map or participant identity capable of changing the inferred route blocks that particular contradiction. All such material must remain in the complete rendering.

development_freedom_and_cost: Both passage/facing meanings are unconfirmed guesses. Their Voynich realizations and any segmentation must be chosen once in an explicitly complete development reading, not per picture class.
The literal-join-to-passage bridge is new and defeasible as a manuscript interpretation. It is fixed within this proposal; a later nonlocal influence reading is a different proposal, not a repair.
At most one complete joint dictionary and one fixed grammar for the full nominated prose set. Every guessed type, production, macro expansion and participant binding is charged.
No external source language, historical cosmology, real-world physics or remembered nine-part roster is added.

All admissible occurrence bindings are retained. Unique geometric orientation is not demanded or inferred. If several bindings change the verdict, report ambiguity rather than choose the convenient one.
A purely opaque grammar can encode the same structure; compatibility of the relational description alone does not confirm the English meanings.

future_selection_recipe.pre_target_scope: Only metadata may establish the already admitted complete native prose unit set for f67v2. Freeze every such unit before any content inspection. Do not choose the paragraph containing a desired relation or turn labels/radial fragments into prose paragraphs.
future_selection_recipe.capacity_and_cost: At most three full native paragraphs and 250 raw groups in their entirety, at most 70 new whole-type guesses, eight productions and twelve explicit participant/scope bindings. If there is no owned complete native prose unit, or the full set exceeds these bounds, stop this recipe without dropping units or selecting another page.
future_selection_recipe.necessary_discriminator: The completed reading must contain at least two passage assertions with an explicitly shared intermediate participant, and an independently distinguishable inward-facing/detached comparison. They may occur in one complete paragraph or across the entire frozen unit set with explicit cross-paragraph binding. A single locally fitting word supplies no discriminator.
future_selection_recipe.reader_policy: ZL, IT and RF remain separate complete readings; uncertainty and divergent boundaries are retained. Missing RF paragraph boundaries do not authorize importing ZL boundaries. No pooled score or reader vote.
future_selection_recipe.implementation_limit: First produce a small complete reading and its literal relation/binding table. No graph solver, corpus walk, decoder or new image annotation until root has reviewed whether the existing coarse native evidence is sufficient for the stated contrast.

outcomes.full_reading_contradicts_certified_drawn: Reject that joint literal-continuity account only; preserve facing/influence and inventory rivals.
outcomes.full_reading_compatible: Keep a conditional development account; no lexical confirmation or cross-page transfer.
outcomes.boundary_or_binding_missing: Retain a concrete incomplete draft; do not invent ports, ownership or hidden edges.
outcomes.kernel_has_no_extra_observable_consequen: Do not implement or score; the proposal remains unselected.

predecessors.difference: The old proposal classifies a diagram whole as a return/junction/side outlet. This proposal constrains two complete relational assertions through literal shared participant identity, with facing versus continuity as the fixed alternative. Old ownership and scope blockers are retained.

No attempt to infer complete components from f77 continuous contours or rescue the old detail-expansion hypothesis. Exact port inventories remain missing; this recipe must not reconstruct them from label zones.

That channel/basin/joins draft had no word-owned endpoints and no complete paragraph. This proposal adds a particular pre-existing attached-versus-detached endpoint distinction; complete text/owner binding remains unsupplied.
Exact label/prose repetition across different owners is not co-reference. Endpoint identity must be explicit in the joint hypothesis and cannot follow merely from an exact string.

predecessors.relation: positive native premise, original stop preserved
predecessors.difference: No diagram isomorphism, 180-degree alignment, common text, shared names or nine-object identity is claimed.
Does not generate geometry through straightedge/compass instructions; checks consequences of a complete relation account against already recorded topology.

known_blockers: No complete fixed Voynich reading or jointly bound endpoints are currently supplied.
The native source is coarse, single-observer source-bound evidence, not independent semantic confirmation.

If the available source only certifies direct detachment but cannot exclude an indirect drawn connection relevant to the exact assertion, that assertion remains unresolved; no zero-edge assumption may be added.
The kernel may remain too weak to discriminate a fully opaque structural grammar. This is explicitly an unreviewed semantic candidate, not a selected test.

sources.claim: Exact existing native observation and source-image hashes; no new pixels opened.
Attached axial versus detached inward-facing corner contrast and explicit transfer stop.
Boundary/port measurement stop; cannot invent component cuts.
Incomplete NETWORK alternative lacks endpoint ownership and a whole paragraph.
Exact strings cross panel owners; identity is not automatic.

access.execution: No census, score, graph reconstruction or code execution on manuscript content. This RAW does not authorize the future selection or target opening.

claim_ceiling: Conditional meaning-directed development recipe with actual visual premises and explicit missing bindings; zero confirmed words, no selected paragraph, no statistical result.
